text:
mike_sales: CedarBridge wants a 4-week POC. Requirements: on-prem entitlement proxy that terminates SAML, uses SCIM delta for provisioning, and evaluates RBAC via a local OPA. They insist logs stay on-site. Need pricing + blocker list.

toni_se: Clarifying: delta-only SCIM? mTLS for callbacks? assertion export allowed?

mike_sales: Delta only. mTLS required. No assertion export unless contractually approved.

lia_pse: Techwise we can ship a Private connector VM with OPA sidecar. Decision logs written locally; metrics can be aggregated and sent only with opt-in.

owen_infra: Notes: recommend durable queue with 48h replay, ACME or manual cert rotation, HSM optional. SCIM bulk imports over air-gap will be slow.

legal_qa: Flag: storing SAML assertions may be PII; we need retention policy in SQA and DPA tweaks if anything leaves site.

mike_sales: Action items: owen -> SOW + ports; lia -> OPA example + mapping doc; toni -> SCIM retry docs; legal_qa -> SQA draft. I'll book presales call Wed 09:30 PT. :thumbsup:
